_provenance.purpose: Record of every HTTP request made during this feasibility spike, and the exact access status of each target domain.
_provenance.note_on_counts: Original spike made 39 requests across 4 product pages (2 Aldi Nord, 2 Lidl). A follow-up extraction-robustness check made 3 further requests (3 additional Aldi Nord products: Weizenmehl, Bananen, Langkorn Reis) -> 42 requests / 5 Aldi Nord product pages. The Lidl/Aldi store-locator follow-up made 11 further requests, of which 2 were product pages -> 53 requests / 7 product pages (5 Aldi Nord, 2 Lidl) and 2 store pages. Counts here are cumulative. CORRECTION: earlier revisions of this file stated "5 product pages total", which conflated the Aldi-only count with the across-chain total. The correct totals are 7 product pages and 53 requests.

constraints_upheld.javascript_execution: NONE - curl only, no headless browser
constraints_upheld.user_agent_spoofing: NONE - a single honest identifying UA was used for every request; no browser impersonation
constraints_upheld.retry_after_block: NONE - blocked domains were NOT retried with altered request characteristics
constraints_upheld.private_api_reverse_engineering: NONE - only robots.txt-advertised sitemaps and ordinary page HTML were used

domains.block_evidence: Akamai edge: response body 'Access Denied' with reference link to errors.edgesuite.net

domains.action_taken: Followed robots.txt-advertised sitemaps; fetched 5 product pages from the allowed /produkt/ path (2 in the original spike, 3 in the follow-up robustness check) and 1 store detail page.
domains.store_locator_finding: SOLVED, and richer than expected. Store pages expose props.pageProps.storeDetail in __NEXT_DATA__ with lat 54.16939, lng 12.083483, zip 18119 (the postcode the sitemap URL omits), 7 openingHours entries, dated specialOpeningHours, services and paymentOptions. Coordinates are exact store positions, not postcode centroids: 0.56 km from the 18119 centroid but 2.2-10.9 km from neighbouring Rostock centroids. Aldi has NO city index page (/filialen-und-oeffnungszeiten/rostock.html is 404; the bare city path 308-redirects to it), so enumeration must use the store sitemap, unlike Lidl.
domains.banner_finding: openingHoursNotes names the operating Regionalgesellschaft ('ALDI GmbH & Co. Kommanditgesellschaft, Anklamer Str. 9, 17126 Jarmen'). Each store therefore identifies its own regional legal entity, so per-banner assortment modelling is derivable from the locator payload. Closes open question 2 for Aldi Nord.
domains.negative_finding: 8 application/ld+json blocks are present but none is a Store/LocalBusiness entity. Address and opening hours exist only inside the Next.js payload, so a generic schema.org harvest would find nothing on Aldi Nord.

domains.block_evidence: robots.txt is served, but shop/product/sitemap paths return a 403 HTML shell whose <title> is 'REWE Onlineshop' - i.e. an edge block with a generic fallback page. No product markup, no JSON-LD, no GTIN.
domains.action_taken: One GET to a path that robots.txt explicitly Allow:s. Documented. No circumvention attempted.

domains.sitemap_finding: https://netto.de/sitemap.xml returns 560 URLs, ZERO of which are product pages. Segments are: angebote, prospekte, marktsuche, netto-eigenmarken, nettoeigenmarken, karriere, presse, impressum, datenschutz, rezepte, nachhaltigkeit and similar corporate/marketing pages.
domains.action_taken: Downloaded and analysed the sitemap locally. Concluded netto.de is a corporate site; it advertises no per-product pages. No product pages attempted.

domains.block_evidence: robots.txt returned 403 (the likely real Netto online grocery shop)

domains.action_taken: Fetched the robots.txt-advertised product sitemap, then 2 product pages. Onsite search deliberately NOT used (Disallow: *search?q=*). A later follow-up re-fetched the sitemap index, the product sitemap and the robots-advertised store sitemap, fetched 2 further product pages and 1 city page (8 requests).
domains.store_locator_finding: SOLVED. City pages (e.g. /s/de-DE/filialen/rostock/) expose exact store -> street + postcode + city via anchor aria-label 'Lidl Filiale {street}, {PLZ} {city}'. 10 Rostock stores extracted, each with a valid 5-digit postcode. Server-rendered, no JavaScript needed. No coordinates on the page, but the postcode is sufficient to join the plz_geocoord centroid dataset.
domains.grocery_price_finding: RULED OUT as a price source. The advertised 13,337-product catalog is ~99% non-food and alcohol (top own-brand families: esmara clothing 1746, livarno furniture 1138, parkside tools 1117, crivit sportswear 794, lupilu baby 657, silvercrest kitchenware 531). A genuine grocery (Belbake Bio Dinkel-Mehl, p10079984) returned gtin=null, price=null and offers.availability='InStoreOnly'. A non-food item (p100409619) returned price 9.99 + 2 GTINs and availability='OnlineOnly'. Derived rule: OnlineOnly => price and GTIN present; InStoreOnly (the real grocery range) => neither. Resolving a grocery price appears to require the store-selection flow via /user-api/* and /cqe/*, BOTH robots-disallowed and therefore NOT probed.
domains.false_positive_warning: Slug substring 'brot' does not mean bread. 'silvercrest-brot-frischhaltedose' (p100409619) is a bread-freshness storage container, not bread. Slug-based grocery classification must use whole-token matching.
